description: This file contains test helper classes and functions for cookie store testing in the Chromium project, including mock implementations, dispatchers, and utility functions related to cookies.

classes.name: DelayedCookieMonsterChangeDispatcher
classes.description: A mock dispatcher that delays cookie change notifications.

classes.name: DelayedCookieMonster
classes.description: A mock cookie store that simulates asynchronous cookie operations with delay.

classes.name: CookieURLHelper
classes.description: A helper class for constructing and formatting cookie-related URLs.

classes.name: FlushablePersistentStore
classes.description: A mock persistent cookie store that tracks flush calls.

classes.name: CallbackCounter
classes.description: A reference-counted class that counts callback invocations.

methods.name: SetCanonicalCookieAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets a canonical cookie, invoking callback immediately.

methods.name: GetCookieListWithOptionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves cookie list with options.

methods.name: GetAllCookiesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all cookies.

methods.name: DeleteCanonicalCookieAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a specific cookie.

methods.name: DeleteAllCreatedInTimeRangeAsync
methods.description: Deletes cookies created within a specified time range asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteAllMatchingInfoAsync
methods.description: Deletes cookies matching certain info asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteSessionCookiesAsync
methods.description: Deletes session cookies asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteMatchingCookiesAsync
methods.description: Deletes cookies matching a predicate asynchronously.

methods.name: FlushStore
methods.description: Flushes the cookie store asynchronously.

methods.name: GetChangeDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the cookie change dispatcher.

methods.name: SetCookieableSchemes
methods.description: Sets schemes that cookies can be set for.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads cookies from persistent store.

methods.name: LoadCookiesForKey
methods.description: Loads cookies for a specific key.

methods.name: AddCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the store.

methods.name: UpdateCookieAccessTime
methods.description: Updates access time for a cookie.

methods.name: DeleteCookie
methods.description: Deletes a specific cookie.

methods.name: SetForceKeepSessionState
methods.description: Forces session cookies to be kept.

methods.name: SetBeforeCommitCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be called before commit.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the store, invoking callback when done.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Increments callback count.

methods.name: callback_count
methods.description: Returns the number of times callback was invoked.

methods.name: FutureCookieExpirationString
methods.description: Generates a future expiration string for cookies.
